rows.title: If the description changes in another tab or device while the STAR Optimizer is open, Apply puts the rewrite as loose text at the top of the description and leaves the original bullet in place
rows.summary: Now: at Apply, a saved Range that is no longer in the editor or no longer covers the text the optimizer opened on (a value adopted from another tab or a cloud pull collapsed it to the editor's start) is dropped; the statement is found again by its text in the new content (statementRange with the caret in each line, else a text node holding it) and replaced there. With no such statement left, the rewrite is added as a new bullet, never as loose text at offset 0.

rows.title: Job scanner reads figures with a unit other than K/M/B ('3x', '10x', '200ms', '#1', '1st') as missing keywords, and '+' writes them into Skills
rows.summary: Now: jobKeywordOf's figure rule (FIGURE in src/utils/atsChecker.js) also drops a number with a multiplier or unit (x, ms, s, sec, min, h, hr, kb/mb/gb/tb/pb), an ordinal (st/nd/rd/th), a range of them and a '#' rank, so '#1', '200ms', '10x', '3x', '2-3x', '16GB', '1st' are neither keywords nor missing keywords; S3, EC2, 5G, Web3, 3D, 2FA, C#, C++ stay keywords.

rows.title: Public résumé page keeps showing, and downloading, the previous résumé after the tab moves to another share link
rows.summary: Now: PublicResume keeps each read with the shareId it was for and shows it only for that link, so moving the tab to another /r/<id> shows 'Loading the résumé…' (no Download PDF of the previous résumé) until the new copy is read; a download under way and its error are tagged with their link and never show on another. docs/knowledge/05-state-auth-sync.md says so.
